title: Gian Giacomo Medici, marquis of Marignano, to Ferrante Gonzaga, Ratisbon, 12 June 1546 (Biblioteca Estense, Autografoteca Campori; not in the catalogue): the cipher of c. 13r read from the contemporary clear translation on c. 14r

documents.shelfmark: Biblioteca Estense Universitaria, Modena, Autografoteca Campori, Lettera M, Medici (de'), Gian Giacomo (1497-1556), cc. 13-16 (cipher on c. 13r; clear translation on c. 14r)
documents.route: Ratisbon (Regensburg) -> Ferrante Gonzaga, governor of Milan

plaintext.source: Contemporary clear translation of the whole cipher passage at the top of c. 14r (transcribed in clear_c14r.txt). The archive record says: 'La c. 14 contiene traduzione della porzione cifrata della lettera.' A transcription job, not a break.

transcription.source: Biblioteca Estense IIIF images (edl-jarvis.cultura.gov.it), full size
transcription.notes: Pass 1 by eye on line strips, not blind (the reader had seen c. 14r); pass 2 by a separate AI agent from a shape legend only, blind; 53 of 306 units differed (about half naming only), settled on full-size crops. Independent blind check of the whole cipher: 9 of about 306 differed (2.9%), 1 solver error (corrected), 2 open f/sigma shapes with the same value. Token count: 239 sign units, punctuation and clear words excluded.

system.summary: Letter substitution with two or more signs for each vowel, in signs that look like Latin letters (with other values) and others (double-crossed sign, daggered 3, delta, hooked d, dotted x, tailed x, loop). A sigma-shaped null, dotted-vowel groups as nulls or stops, one code (eti = V. Ecc.a), clear words mixed in, double letters written once. Words divided by commas and slashes.
system.notes: distinct_symbols and the null count are over the 239 sign units of transcription_c13r.txt (clear words and punctuation excluded). Seven sign names (g e + f q N o) and u carry two values; most are probably two similar shapes merged in the transcription, not split on the image.

prior_solution.where: Checked 3 Nov 2026: this repository (catalogue, leads, targets, research notes) and its open PRs have no target or lead for this letter; one web search (Marignano, Ferrante Gonzaga, 1546, Ratisbona, cifra, Lutherani) found no edition or decipherment. One search is not proof that none exists. The contemporary translation on c. 14r is itself a decipherment.

conditions.human_role: WAINUT set the task and the rules (key frozen before the held-out lines, blind second pass, independent check). AI language-model agents transcribed, built the key, read and checked. No target-specific human intervention. No human palaeographer checked the text.
tools: scripts/fetch.py, mstrips.py, mzoom.py, pass2_blind.py (need the images, Pillow, numpy)
models: AI language-model agents (WAINUT), viewing the images

solution.what: Canvases of cc. 13-16 fetched from the Estense IIIF service, one request at a time; the cipher region of c. 13r at full size.
Keys held in the repository for Ferrante's correspondents tested on the first pairs: ferrante1549 (Charles V and Philip) and ercole1544 (Ercole Gonzaga). Neither fits.
Pass 1 by eye on line strips (not blind); pass 2 by a separate AI agent from a legend of shapes only (blind); 53 of 306 differences settled on full-size crops (validation/adjudication.tsv).
Cipher words of lines M01-M06 aligned with the clear translation on c. 14r; key frozen (key_frozen.tsv).

Held-out lines M07-M10 with the frozen key: 74 of 82 units agree with the reading (75 after the quale correction); 1000 shuffled tables mean 8.1, max 28. Scored against our own reading of M07-M10, itself aligned to c. 14r; a two-valued sign name counts if either value matches.
Reading written line by line with every departure marked; scripts/check_marks.py rebuilds the decryption and fails on any unmarked departure. 62 cipher words, all read as sense.
Repository and open PRs searched; one web search. No edition or decipherment found.

Independent blind check (VERIFY.md): whole cipher copied by shape, 9 of about 306 differences (2.9%), 1 solver error (M08 quale: g, not 9), 2 open; c. 14r read blind; rebuild matches byte for byte; fault injection shows the checker cannot see a wrong pick on a two-valued sign name.

Corrections applied: M08 quale 9 -> g (checked on a full-size crop against the g of quanto and the 9 of si and resolta); M01 l marked doubtful as in the adjudication log; English translation corrected; the checker now lists two-valued picks.

outcome.method_basis: The contemporary clear translation on c. 14r covers the whole cipher of c. 13r; the key was rebuilt by aligning the cipher with it, frozen on six lines and tested on four.
outcome.fraction_read_source: scripts/check_marks.py on reading_marked_c13r.txt: 62 cipher words, all read as sense (55 straight from the signs, 7 with a marked repair); clear words on the page not counted.

texts.label: 12 June 1546, c. 13r (cipher)
texts.summary: From the imperial court at Ratisbon, Marignano tells Ferrante Gonzaga that the war against the Lutherans is decided. Provisions are being made and he has a large part in them; the preparation is great and he will send a detailed report by the next courier. The court professes to keep the matter secret, though it is already public; Ferrante is not to name him as the source.
texts.note: Words 62: all read as sense, 55 straight from the signs, 4 with a restored double letter, 2 on a doubtful sign (di [?l]a, aviso [?a]), 1 read against the sign's value (pu{b}lica). Every word matches the contemporary translation on c. 14r. 29 letters (plus 11 u/v) rest on a two-valued sign name, each picked to match c. 14r.

reading_review.by: AI language-model agent (for WAINUT; a model reading, not a person), independent of the solver
reading_review.note: Coherent Italian that matches c. 14r word for word apart from the scribe's spellings (di la, grando, auctore, primo for p.o). The marked line-by-line reading matches the signs and passes check_marks. Weak places: pu{b}lica read against the sign; 'non mi ne fac(c)ia me auctore' is redundant but matches the gloss; the doubtful l of di la (now marked); the {?a} after aviso. The English translation was graded B: 'Your Excellency' was repeated in the report sentence, impersonal 'si cognoscera' was given V. Ecc.a as subject, and 'more than my share of it' was loose; the first two were corrected after the review, the third reworded.

gaps.item: Doubtful signs: l? (M01), j'? (M07), o? (M09, publica read against the sign)
gaps.detail: Single occurrences; every word confirmed by c. 14r.

gaps.item: f or sigma s in actende (M02) and auctore (M10)
gaps.detail: Open after the independent check; same value either way.
Nulls or stop marks; four occurrences, not proved either way.

outcome.notes: Not unread pieces, so not listed as gaps, but open: (1) seven sign names (g e + f q N o) and u carry two values; 29 letters of the reading (plus 11 u/v) rest on such a pick, fixed by matching c. 14r and not checked by scripts/check_marks.py; the shapes were not split on the image. (2) The clear rest of the letter (c. 13r-v) and the postscript on c. 14r were not transcribed. (3) Prior art: one web search only; editions of Ferrante Gonzaga's correspondence were not opened. (4) One letter only: the key has no second text to be tested on outside its own pairs.
